meta.ranking: multi-day events (consecutive days with >=0.10 in at either gauge, one dry day allowed, light edges trimmed) ranked by the larger of the two gauge totals, 2006-01-01 to 2026-09-20
meta.hourly: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS 1-hour precipitation (p01i), routine hourly reports; T = 0.005 in; each series starts seven days before the ranked event so antecedent conditions are real
meta.recorded: MWRD pumping-station discharge log in data/mwrd-ps-cso-activity.csv, summed over the event window plus two days
meta.caveat: Gauges are point measurements; convective storms vary sharply between them. The model rains each basin by inverse-distance weighting of the gauges around its centroid.
